== English errata comparison sources ==
The original default and high-resolution faces have no uniqueness dot. Appendix A (PDF page 110) explicitly makes the Effect unique; the current PC faces show the dot. Full game text and lore are unchanged. This comparison records the uniqueness difference, not a game-text rewrite.

Reprints and Virtual editions remain outside these English original-card comparison columns.
